scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && export PORT=3000 && pnpm run db:ensure && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.db:ensure: node --input-type=module -e "import { createRequire } from 'module'; const req = createRequire(new URL('file://' + process.cwd() + '/../../lib/db/package.json')); const { Client } = req('pg'); const c = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); await c.connect().catch(e => { console.warn('[DB] Cannot connect:', e.message); process.exit(0); }); await c.query('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector').catch(() => {}); await c.end(); console.log('[DB] pgvector ready');" && pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push || echo '[DB] Schema push failed — tables may already exist'
